@@U02418@@
(To the CROWD. )

@@U02419@@
I have strewn among you
my finest gifts.
On this head and that I see
glowing a tiny flame
I sparked into life.
It leaps lightly
from one to another;
on this head it lingers,
on others not,
and only rarely
does it flare up
and in a brief flowering
illuminate all around it.
Sadly, on most,
it dies out, unrecognized.

@@U02421@@
—Do you see?
—Up there?
—On the chariot?
—A charlatan!
—And behind him a clown!
—I’ve never seen him so thin!
—Skin and bones!
—Pinch him, he'd never feel it!

@@U02423@@
Women!
Ah! They disgust me!
Keep them away!
I know I’ll never suit them!
In days when women ran the house,
my name was Madam Avarice.
Things were well run then,
house in good order,
much coming 1n,
nothing going out!
I kept a sharp eye on chests and cupboards
translation:
@@U02418@@
（致人群。）

@@U02419@@
我散布在你们中间
我最好的礼物。
在我所看到的这个头上
发出微小的火焰
我焕发出生命的火花。
它轻轻地跳跃
从一个到另一个；
它徘徊在这个头上，
在其他人身上则不然，
并且很少有
它会爆发吗
并在短暂的开花期
照亮它周围的一切。
可悲的是，在大多数情况下，
它消失了，不被认识。

@@U02421@@
——你看到了吗？
——在上面吗？
——战车上？
——江湖骗子！
——他身后有一个小丑！
——我从来没见过他这么瘦过！
——皮肤和骨头！
——掐他一下，他根本感觉不到！

@@U02423@@
女人！
啊!他们令我厌恶！
让他们远离！
我知道我永远不会适合他们！
在女人操持家务的年代，
我的名字是贪婪女士。
那时事情进展顺利，
房子秩序井然，
即将到来 1n，
没有出去！
我密切关注箱子和橱柜
